arguments.analyst: R3: single-substitution observations (O6 L15Q 3.764, O7 I47V 3.771, O10 P187T 3.732, O9 A179S 3.604) all retain brightness, while O8 E213K collapses to 1.302, showing position-specific tolerance. Model menu clusters ~3.42-3.52 for many two-edit combos; test whether combining benign permissive positions (I47V, P187T, L15Q) preserves/improves brightness versus nearby menu scores.
arguments.hypothesis: Benign single substitutions at I47V and P187T are additive-compatible, so a candidate carrying I47V (C07/C12/C32 family) or P187-adjacent edits should score near or above 3.44, whereas any design introducing a disruptive polar/charged change at a sensitive surface position (E213K-like) will drop far below 3.0.

decision.hypothesis: Benign single substitutions at I47V and P187T are additive-compatible, so a candidate carrying I47V (C07/C12/C32 family) or P187-adjacent edits should score near or above 3.44, whereas any design introducing a disruptive polar/charged change at a sensitive surface position (E213K-like) will drop far below 3.0.
decision.critic: Estimates are fitted, not measured; C22 and C05 uncertainty is moderate and C08 high, so predicted ranking may not reflect true fluorescence.
